desc:
Welcome to Car Slide! A ROBLOX game where you can zoom down hills, pull off epic slides, and dodge wild obstacles in this thrilling Roblox ride. Get ready for high-speed fun and adrenaline-pumping action!

At 70% Likes, Huge update!!!

Take a car and drive down and dodge the rocks !
If your car touches a rock your car will be damaged !
Have Fun !!!
